subject: Account health: billing evidence needed for FYQ3 forecast

From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>

Cc: accounts@acme-analytics.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Account health: billing evidence needed for FYQ3 forecast

Morning team — quick ask to tidy Acme Analytics in the forecast before Friday's close. Finance flagged a mismatch between our Q2 usage and the invoices Acme uploaded to the portal. To lock Q3 ARR coverage I need the following by EOD Thu (17 Jun):

- Confirm stage for ACME-7821 in the forecast tool (Committed vs Commit Pending).
- Upload the detailed usage report (CSV) that maps to the invoice line items.
- Provide the signed SOW or renewal confirmation (PDF).

I attached what we have so far. If we can get the CSV + invoice copy, Finance will accept the evidence and we can keep the current coverage. If not, we'll need to mark partial coverage which impacts the Q3 close.

Attachments: [Attachment: acme_usage_Q2.csv (csv)], [Attachment: acme_invoice_q2_2026.pdf (pdf)]

Thanks —
Olga

Aditya / Olga — thanks for the heads up. We found the portal invoice but the attachment doesn't include per-feature usage. Finance on our side needs a CSV with daily token counts and model variants per invoice line to reconcile. Two questions:

1) Can Redwood accept a daily-aggregated CSV (date, model, tokens, cost_center)?
2) We can share the signed SOW, but it was executed by procurement last year — is a scanned PDF okay?

If both are fine, I'll push the files today.

Best,
Trevor Lee
Director, Cloud Ops | Acme Analytics
trevor@acme-analytics.com
From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>

Cc: Grace Oconnor <grace@redwood.com>, accounts@acme-analytics.com
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Account health: billing evidence needed for FYQ3 forecast

Trevor — daily-aggregated CSV is perfect. A scanned PDF of the SOW is also acceptable; Finance just needs a signed copy with execution date. I'll drop a checklist below and attach a signed copy of the latest SOW (we had one on file, attaching for completeness).

Checklist for Acme (to satisfy Finance):
- Daily-aggregated usage CSV mapping to invoice lines [Attachment: acme_usage_Q2.csv]
- Copy of the invoice PDF showing totals and invoice number [Attachment: acme_invoice_q2_2026.pdf]
- Signed SOW confirming renewal/term [Attachment: sow_signed_acme.pdf]

Once we have all three items, I will mark ACME-7821 as Committed in the forecast and notify FinOps. Also linking the HubSpot deal for reference: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/ACME-7821

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Olga
Revenue Ops | Redwood Inference
From: Grace Oconnor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts@acme-analytics.com
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Final: ACME-7821 marked Committed in forecast

All — Acme delivered the CSV and signed SOW this morning; I uploaded the files to the forecast evidence tab and attached the invoice PDF to the deal record. I've updated the stage to Committed in our forecasting tool and left a note for FinOps to re-run the coverage check.

Action items completed:
- Stage updated to Committed
- Evidence uploaded (CSV + SOW + invoice)
- HubSpot deal comment added: "Evidence accepted by Revenue Ops — Committed"

If Finance needs anything else, ping me and I'll surface it. Good close for the Q3 coverage.

—Grace
Revenue Operations Analyst | Redwood Inference
